name: Deep Debugging: Transaction Isolation and Canonical Hash Chain
prompt:
Diagnose and resolve two subtle defects in transactional_cache.py and hash_chain.py:
R1: In transactional_cache.py, ensure rollback fully isolates nested dictionary mutations made during an uncommitted transaction.
R2: In hash_chain.py, enforce canonical serialization (sort_keys=True, compact separators, and NFC unicode normalization) so block verification remains tamper-evident and invariant across key ordering and unicode representations.
R3: Preserve thread safety and test invariants; all unit tests in test_deep_debug.py must pass.
Allowed paths: transactional_cache.py, hash_chain.py, test_deep_debug.py.
